title: Case: International shipment is cleared but awaiting last-mile handover
context: The international carrier has a recorded clearance release, but the last-mile carrier has not yet confirmed receipt. Transfer support must establish physical handover.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the carrier's transfer team for the local carrier reference and handover status.

must_not: Clearance and local receipt do not establish final delivery or a promised arrival time.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Please confirm DL-3890’s physical last-mile handover and obtain the matching local reference from Plover Arc. A planned assignment alone is insufficient.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-048: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. 44 irrelevant events turn this into a long thread; the decisive events are the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
